In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.
tldr: 提出分层高斯场HierGF，通过几何感知消息传递生成伪监督，提升稀疏视图重建的多视图一致性与欠采样区域质量。
motivation: 稀疏视图仅含有限三维信息，导致多视图一致性难以建立，且视图覆盖不足使欠采样区域结构缺失。现有方法依赖有限重投影误差与正则项，易过拟合单视图并产生跨视图外观不一致，在几何欠采样区域依赖启发式密度控制，常出现模糊和结构空洞。
method: HierGF从分层几何感知视角出发，利用两阶段几何感知骨干网络将粗三维几何信息和额外二维生成先验转化为结构化伪监督，从而以极少输入视图增强多视图一致性。同时引入可学习置信度网络引导梯度关注跨视图一致内容，并设计几何一致稠密化模块改善多视图对齐和欠采样区域重建。
result: 摘要未提供相关信息
conclusion: HierGF将有限观测转化为可靠的自我生成监督，超越固定先验和启发式密度控制，缓解稀疏视图重建中的过拟合、外观不一致与结构缺失问题，有望推动AR/VR内容创建、文化遗产数字化和机器人等应用。

title: VASC: Value-Aware Sparse Attention with Cross-Layer Memory for Efficient 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. Code is available at https://github.com/kosakayamahoo-design/VASC.
tldr: VASC是一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过值感知块选择和跨层记忆，在保持3D重建质量的同时加速VGGT等前馈3D视觉模型的推理。
motivation: 前馈3D视觉模型（如VGGT）采用二次全局注意力，导致长图像序列计算成本高昂；现有稀疏方法可能偏向高注意力但值冗余的区域，造成信息损失。
method: VASC结合值感知的块选择与执行感知的跨层记忆。值感知块选择综合池化后的查询-键相关性和邻近值对比度，减少冗余并保留查询相关且独特的内容；跨层记忆跟踪未满足的需求，并根据实际执行更新状态，使之前未被充分服务的块在固定计算预算下参与竞争。
result: 在7Scenes和NeuralRGB-D数据集上，使用VGGT和π^3，VASC相比FasterVGGT提升了位姿估计和重建质量，推理速度比密集VGGT快达2.29倍。
conclusion: VASC是一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，有效加速前馈3D重建模型，同时提升或保持精度，为高效3D视觉提供了新思路。代码已开源。

title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
abstract: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.
tldr: 提出RelationVGGT，在无位姿多视图下以前馈方式分割关系文本指定的目标，无需类别名。
motivation: 现有3D重建与语义场景理解虽已转向前馈推理，但仍局限于以物体为中心的感知，忽略物体间空间关系。本文定义前馈、无位姿的多视图3D空间关系分割任务：给定视觉指定的主体和关系文本查询，跨视图分割目标且不提供其类别名。
method: RelationVGGT融合视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D几何基础模型的几何感知表示，并利用关系Transformer进行主体条件化的跨视图关系预测，无需逐场景优化与已知相机位姿。同时基于ScanNet++构建由VLM和LLM驱动的全自动标注流程，以可扩展地生成该新任务的训练数据。
result: 摘要未提供相关信息
conclusion: 提出RelationVGGT框架与相应全自动标注流程，将3D空间关系分割拓展到前馈、无位姿多视图设定，贡献新任务定义、关系感知方法与可扩展数据生成方案。该工作有望推动关系感知的3D场景理解及无需位姿的多视图分割研究。

title: Machine Translation for Sign Languages
abstract: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Advances in pose estimation, transformer architectures, and large-scale dataset collection have driven progress, yet challenges remain. Datasets are limited compared to spoken-language resources; evaluation metrics inadequately capture the linguistic quality of output; and models must capture the simultaneous, multi-layered, and three-dimensional structure of sign languages. This manuscript provides a comprehensive review that seeks to balance technical challenges with stakeholder considerations. We examine the linguistic properties that make sign languages computationally unique, trace the evolution of recognition, translation, and production systems, and analyze ongoing technical challenges. Crucially, we address ethical considerations around data governance, community involvement, and appropriate use. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives spanning computer vision, sign language linguistics, and deaf studies, our analysis emphasizes that continued progress requires sustained collaboration across these fields and with deaf communities.
tldr: 本文综述手语机器翻译的技术演进、数据与评估挑战，并强调伦理及聋人社群协作的重要性。
motivation: 手语机器翻译已从孤立手语识别发展到端到端翻译，但数据集规模远不及口语资源，评估指标难以充分反映输出语言质量，且模型需建模手语同时、多层和三维结构。本文旨在系统梳理这些技术挑战与利益相关者考量。
method: 文章开展综合性综述，考察手语在计算上独特的语言属性，追溯识别、翻译与生成系统的演进，并分析持续存在的技术挑战。同时结合计算机视觉、手语语言学和聋人研究等跨学科视角，讨论数据治理、社区参与和适当使用等伦理问题。
result: 摘要未提供相关信息
conclusion: 本文的贡献在于以跨学科视角平衡技术挑战与利益相关者诉求，指出手语机器翻译的持续进步需要跨领域协作并与聋人社群保持长期合作。

title: StreamRig: Exploiting Intra-Rig Geometry for Streaming Multi-Camera Odometry
abstract: Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons. Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig.
tldr: StreamRig 冻结多视角3D基础模型，仅训练轻量模块实现标定多相机因果流式里程计。
motivation: 移动机器人与车辆常配备同步多相机 rig，但许多流式3D基础模型仅面向单目输入，难以高效利用相机 rig 的几何约束。该工作旨在解决如何在不重训基础模型的前提下，实现标定多相机 rig 的因果流式里程计。
method: 提出 freeze-and-stream 框架：冻结的多视角3D基础模型在 rig 标定下联合感知同步视图，Rig-Resampler 压缩特征，CausalBridge 使用带键值缓存的因果注意力，轻量头回归 rig 位姿，并用周期性重锚定协议保持长序列稳定。仅训练约74.6M参数模块，以相对位姿为唯一监督，采用组重定位预训练与因果 rig 训练的两阶段策略迁移几何先验和配准能力。
result: 在 NCLT、TartanGround、KITTI-360 及自采人形机器人数据集 ZJH 上，训练仅用仿真、真实评估为 zero-shot；StreamRig 在所有四个数据集上的平移与旋转漂移均低于所评估的非 oracle 单目流式模型和 rig-aware 离线模型，并保持较低推理成本。消融与受控相机数量实验识别了性能来源，并考察了更长训练窗口对长时域推理的影响。
conclusion: StreamRig 证明了冻结多视角3D基础模型并结合轻量流式模块，可高效利用 intra-rig 几何实现多相机流式里程计，并具备仿真到真实 zero-shot 泛化与长序列稳定性。代码已开源，有望推动机器人/车辆多相机定位的实用部署。

title: BatSLAM 2.0: Sequence-Verified Sonar Place Recognition in a Robust Pose Graph
abstract: Echolocating bats can navigate dark and cluttered spaces using echolocation. Over a decade ago, BatSLAM showed that a robot with a biomimetic binaural sonar can build a topological map of the environment, by recognizing places from the received acoustic signals. Sonar place recognition, however, is ambiguous by nature: corridors produce nearly identical echo trains, and wrong loop closure can collapse the topological map. In this paper, we introduce BatSLAM 2.0, a novel sonar-only SLAM system built from three elements: an updated acoustic front-end, a sequence verifier that tracks and verifies loop closure candidates and a pose graph implemented on a high performance factor graph framework. The system was thoroughly evaluated both in simulated as well as real world recordings. In both cases, the BatSLAM2.0 algorithm shows the capability of robust topological map creation, countering map collapse, and robust scaling of map size.
tldr: 提出BatSLAM 2.0，通过序列验证声呐闭环候选并在因子图位姿图中实现稳健的纯声呐拓扑SLAM。
motivation: 声呐位置识别存在固有歧义，走廊等环境产生几乎相同的回声序列，错误闭环会导致拓扑地图崩溃；因此需要面向仿生双耳声呐的稳健纯声呐SLAM方法。
method: BatSLAM 2.0由三部分组成：更新的声学前端、用于跟踪并验证闭环候选的序列验证器，以及基于高性能因子图框架实现的位姿图。
result: 在仿真和真实世界录音中均进行了评估，系统表现出稳健的拓扑地图创建能力，可抵抗地图坍缩并实现地图规模的稳健扩展；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作提出了纯声呐SLAM系统BatSLAM 2.0，通过序列验证与鲁棒位姿图提升闭环可靠性，对黑暗杂乱环境中的仿生机器人导航具有潜在影响。

title: Reconstructing the Dynamic World: A Representation-Centric View of 4D Scene Reconstruction
abstract: 4D scene reconstruction aims to recover the evolving geometry, appearance, and motion of dynamic environments from visual observations. Despite substantial progress in neural scene representations, reconstructing dynamic scenes remains challenging due to non-rigid motion, occlusions, temporal inconsistencies, and the trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency. Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have introduced diverse approaches to representing and reconstructing dynamic scenes, yet their relationships, underlying design choices, and evaluation protocols remain fragmented. In this paper, we present a unified perspective on 4D scene reconstruction, organizing existing methods around their scene representations, temporal modeling strategies, reconstruction pipelines, and optimization objectives. Through this framework, we examine how different design choices affect geometric fidelity, appearance consistency, motion representation, and computational efficiency. We further consolidate commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, identify limitations in current experimental practices, and discuss open challenges in reconstructing complex, dynamic real-world environments. By connecting methodological developments with their underlying assumptions and evaluation evidence, this work provides a structured foundation for understanding existing approaches and identifying future research directions. An evolving collection of relevant papers and resources is available at https://github.com/ZiyangYan/Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction.
tldr: 本文从表示角度统一综述4D动态场景重建，梳理方法、数据集与评估，并指出开放挑战。
motivation: 4D场景重建需从视觉观测恢复动态环境的几何、外观与运动，但受非刚性运动、遮挡、时序不一致及重建保真度与计算效率权衡影响，现有NeRF与3DGS方法的关系、设计选择与评估协议较为分散。
method: 本文提出统一的表示中心视角，围绕场景表示、时序建模策略、重建流程与优化目标组织现有方法，分析不同设计选择对几何保真度、外观一致性、运动表示和计算效率的影响；同时汇总常用数据集与评价指标，指出现有实验实践的局限，并讨论复杂动态真实环境重建的开放挑战。
result: 摘要未提供相关信息
conclusion: 该综述连接方法发展、底层假设与评估证据，为理解现有4D场景重建方法及识别未来研究方向提供结构化基础，并维护相关论文与资源集合。

title: Introduction to Computer Vision
abstract: This book presents a code-first introduction to computer vision, spanning classical 2D image processing, classical 3D vision, and deep learning. Organized as 44 short chapters across three parts, the book builds each topic from first principles: image arithmetic and morphology; convolution, pyramids, and frequency-domain filtering; feature detection, optical flow, and stereo; projective geometry, camera calibration, and structure from motion; and the full arc of modern deep learning, from a single neuron through convolutional networks, backpropagation, classic architectures, transfer learning, object detection, and semantic and instance segmentation, concluding with engineering considerations like mixed-precision and parallel training. Every technique is implemented directly in Python and NumPy or PyTorch and checked numerically against the corresponding OpenCV or PyTorch library function, so readers see not just the mathematics but its concrete behavior on real and synthetic data. The material was distilled with AI assistance from freely available online course notes, condensing extensive working code into concise mathematical exposition while preserving verified, reproducible results throughout. It is intended as a self-contained reference for students and practitioners who want to understand computer vision algorithms and their Python implementations.
tldr: 一本代码优先的计算机视觉教材，分44章贯通经典2D、经典3D与深度学习，并用Python/NumPy/PyTorch逐一实现与库函数数值验证。
motivation: 面向希望既理解计算机视觉算法数学原理、又能掌握其Python实现的学生与从业者，提供一本自包含的参考书。现有课程笔记代码冗长零散，缺少从第一性原理出发、且结果经数值验证的统一教材。
method: 全书分为三部分共44个短章节：从图像运算与形态学、卷积/金字塔/频域滤波、特征检测/光流/立体匹配，到投影几何、相机标定、运动恢复结构，再到从单个神经元、卷积网络、反向传播、经典架构、迁移学习、目标检测到语义与实例分割的深度学习全链路，并以混合精度与并行训练等工程实践收尾。每种技术均用Python配合NumPy或PyTorch直接实现，并与OpenCV或PyTorch对应库函数进行数值对照校验；内容借助AI从公开在线课程笔记提炼，将大量工程代码压缩为简洁的数学阐述并保留可复现的验证结果。
result: 摘要未提供相关信息（本书为教材，未报告实验与量化指标）。
conclusion: 该书贡献在于把经典2D视觉、经典3D视觉与现代深度学习整合为一条可动手实现的连续学习路径，所有方法都配有经库函数数值校验的Python代码。可作为自包含的教材与参考手册，帮助读者将数学理解落到真实与合成数据上的具体算法行为。

title: EffGS: Efficient and High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but existing general-purpose acceleration methods suffer severe rendering quality degradation when extended to more complex, large-scale scenes. To address this issue, we propose EffGS, a more general acceleration framework that improves training and rendering efficiency while maintaining reconstruction quality comparable to or better than vanilla 3DGS across bounded and large-scale scenes. EffGS combines frequency-aware guidance, localized density control, and adaptive primitive scale modulation. First, an importance scoring mechanism combines pixel-wise reconstruction errors with a difference-of-Gaussians mask scheduled over training to provide stage-dependent spatial guidance. Second, localized densification and pruning restricts density modifications to Gaussians with valid projected footprints in the sampled views. Third, learnable per-Gaussian scale modulation adjusts effective primitive extent during optimization while retaining the Compact Box rasterization rule. Extensive experiments on bounded and large-scale scene datasets demonstrate a favorable balance between reconstruction quality, training time, and primitive count. Component ablations and matched-primitive-budget comparisons further support the effectiveness of the framework.
tldr: EffGS通过频率感知引导、局部密度控制与自适应尺度调制，在保持重建质量的同时提升3DGS训练与渲染效率。
motivation: 现有3D Gaussian Splatting通用加速方法在扩展到更复杂、大规模场景时会出现严重的渲染质量下降，因此需要一种能在 bounded 与 large-scale 场景中兼顾效率与重建质量的通用加速框架。
method: EffGS融合频率感知引导、局部密度控制与自适应图元尺度调制：用重要度评分结合像素重建误差与随训练调度的 DoG 掩码提供阶段相关空间引导；将致密化与剪枝限制在采样视图中具有有效投影足迹的高斯；并通过可学习的逐高斯尺度调制调整图元有效范围，同时保留 Compact Box 光栅化规则。
result: 在 bounded 与 large-scale 场景数据集上的大量实验表明，EffGS在重建质量、训练时间和图元数量之间取得良好平衡；组件消融与匹配图元预算对比进一步验证了框架有效性。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: EffGS是一种更通用的加速框架，在 bounded 与 large-scale 场景中保持与 vanilla 3DGS 相当或更优的重建质量，同时提升训练与渲染效率，对实时新视角合成与大规模场景重建具有潜在影响。

title: Lens Flare Removal and Reconstruction
abstract: The presence of lens flares in images can significantly reduce the quality of downstream application results for tasks such as 3D scene reconstruction. This is because lens flares are a property of the camera imaging system, and not a part of the underlying scene being modeled. There are previous methods that tackle the removal of small flares focused around a light source. However, existing methods struggle with large flares, such as those that fill the entire image. In this work, we compile a novel dataset for large-flare removal, combining publicly available real-world data with a procedural generation pipeline. We fine-tune a diffusion-based model on our dataset to remove complex, large lens flares. On the other hand, lens flares remain effective artistic tools, widely used in the media. While there are ways to simulate 2D flares, representing and reconstructing lens flares consistently across multiple views has not yet been explored. To achieve this, we introduce a flare representation model that leverages the symmetry of lens flares about the camera's principal point. We propose a computational pipeline to jointly optimize this flare model and a Gaussian splatting model (3DGS). This enables the decomposition of a 3D scene into lens flares and the scene itself, using our flare-removal model. Because the reconstructed flare is explicit and re-renderable, it can be edited and transferred to novel images and new 3D scenes. We evaluate removal on an established benchmark and a new one for large reflective flares, quantify the flare/scene decomposition directly, and show that the pipeline is robust to errors in automatic light-source localization.
tldr: 提出大光晕去除数据集与扩散模型，并基于对称性联合3DGS重建可编辑光晕与场景。
motivation: 镜头光晕是相机成像系统属性而非场景内容，会显著降低3D场景重建等下游任务质量；现有方法仅能处理光源周围小光晕，难以应对充满整幅图像的大光晕。
method: 构建结合真实数据与程序化生成的大光晕去除数据集，微调扩散模型去除复杂大光晕；同时提出利用光晕关于相机主点对称性的光晕表示模型，并与3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）联合优化，实现场景与光晕的分解及可重渲染。
result: 在已有基准及新构建的大型反射光晕基准上评估去除效果，直接量化光晕/场景分解，并证明流程对自动光源定位误差具有鲁棒性；摘要未提供具体数值指标。
conclusion: 该工作将光晕去除与重建统一，既能去除大光晕提升下游重建质量，又能显式重建、编辑和迁移光晕到新图像或新3D场景，拓展了光晕作为艺术工具的多视图表示能力。

title: Emergent Multi-View Geometry Through Self-Distillation
abstract: Over a century ago, Henri Poincaré argued that a motionless observer cannot acquire the notion of space. Yet, most visual representation learning methods operate on individual images, while those that leverage multiple views rely on RGB reconstruction, entangling geometry with appearance. We propose Poincar3, a self-supervised method that learns representations from multiple views through self-distillation instead of RGB reconstruction. We combine masked patch and image-level distillation with a teacher that observes additional views, enabling training from scratch without explicit 3D supervision. Poincar3 outperforms both previous single and multi-view self-supervised approaches such as DINOv3, MuM, and Muskie on correspondence estimation, camera pose estimation, and 3D reconstruction. Using a lightweight Poincaré adapter, we also find that our learned features encode camera motion more accurately than existing self-supervised representations.
tldr: Poincar3通过多视图自蒸馏学习表征，无需RGB重建或3D监督，在对应、相机位姿和3D重建上优于现有自监督方法。
motivation: 多数视觉表征学习方法仅处理单张图像，而利用多视图的方法通常依赖RGB重建，将几何与外观耦合，难以获得纯粹的几何表征。受Poincaré关于运动观察者才能获得空间概念的观点启发，本文旨在无需显式3D监督地从多视图学习几何感知表征。
method: 提出Poincar3，一种通过自蒸馏而非RGB重建从多视图学习表征的自监督方法。它结合掩码图像块级蒸馏与图像级蒸馏，并让教师网络观察额外视图，从而无需显式3D监督即可从零训练；同时使用轻量Poincaré适配器分析相机运动编码。
result: 在对应估计、相机位姿估计和3D重建任务上，Poincar3优于DINOv3、MuM、Muskie等先前单视图与多视图自监督方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。借助轻量Poincaré适配器，其学习特征比现有自监督表征更准确地编码相机运动。
conclusion: Poincar3表明，通过多视图自蒸馏可以涌现出多视图几何理解，避免依赖RGB重建和显式3D监督。该工作为对应估计、相机位姿估计与3D重建提供了更强的自监督表征，并展示了从多视图数据中学习几何结构的潜力。

title: GRC-Pose: Generation-Reconstruction Correspondence for Prior-Free 6D Object Pose Tracking
abstract: Prior-free 6D object pose tracking seeks to recover the trajectory of an unseen object from a single RGB video without object-specific CAD models, posed reference images, or pose annotations. Geometric foundation models provide complementary object-centric and scene-centric cues, yet SAM3D CAD is indexed by an arbitrary object-local surface parameterization, whereas reconstructed evidence is expressed in a sequence-specific world frame with partial surface coverage. To exploit this complementarity, we formulate tracking as generation-reconstruction correspondence and introduce GRC-Pose, a correspondence-based framework that combines learned correspondence prediction with robust pose estimation. Concretely, GeoCorr-Matcher estimates weighted object-scene correspondences and per-match uncertainty for each pose candidate. FGH-Solver integrates these matches through multiple robust geometric estimators and sequence-level posterior inference, while a posterior-gated memory retains only inlier-supported observations through occlusion and viewpoint change. Extensive evaluation shows that with SAM3D CAD, GRC-Pose achieves state-of-the-art Average Recall and motion retention on HOT3D, improving the latter by 58% over prior art. On classical benchmarks including YCBInEOAT and LINEMOD, it remains highly competitive.
tldr: 提出GRC-Pose，将无先验6D位姿跟踪建模为生成-重建对应，结合对应预测与鲁棒估计。
motivation: 无先验6D物体位姿跟踪需从单目RGB视频恢复未见物体轨迹，且不能依赖CAD模型、已定位参考图或位姿标注。几何基础模型虽提供物体中心与场景中心互补线索，但SAM3D CAD的任意物体局部表面参数化与重建证据的序列特定世界坐标、部分表面覆盖不一致，直接利用困难。
method: GRC-Pose将跟踪形式化为生成-重建对应，结合学习到的对应预测与鲁棒位姿估计。GeoCorr-Matcher为每个位姿候选估计加权物体-场景对应及逐匹配不确定性；FGH-Solver通过多个鲁棒几何估计器和序列级后验推断融合这些匹配，并用后验门控记忆在遮挡和视角变化中仅保留内点支持的观测。
result: 在HOT3D上，结合SAM3D CAD的GRC-Pose取得最优Average Recall和motion retention，其中motion retention较先前方法提升58%。在YCBInEOAT和LINEMOD等经典基准上仍具强竞争力。
conclusion: GRC-Pose无需物体特定先验，通过生成-重建对应有效融合几何基础模型线索，实现鲁棒6D物体位姿跟踪，并展现对无先验跟踪的潜在影响。

title: UGOD: Uncertainty-Guided Opacity and Dropout for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting is prone to overfitting because limited observations leave many Gaussian primitives weakly constrained, yet their contributions are still accumulated through alpha blending. Without uncertainty estimation, the renderer cannot distinguish unreliable primitives from well-constrained ones, allowing their erroneous contributions to corrupt novel-view synthesis. We introduce UGOD, an uncertainty-guided framework that estimates a view-dependent uncertainty score for each Gaussian and uses it to regulate its rendering contribution. A lightweight uncertainty head conditioned on Gaussian attributes and viewing direction predicts this score, which then drives a differentiable opacity-modulation mechanism that attenuates high-uncertainty primitives before compositing. During training, a detached soft-dropout branch applies an uncertainty-controlled continuous keep mask to discourage the model from relying on poorly constrained Gaussians and thereby reduce overfitting. Crucially, detaching the uncertainty score prevents gradients from this stochastic regulariser from biasing or collapsing the uncertainty prediction. Experiments on Mip-NeRF~360 and LLFF show that UGOD improves sparse-view novel-view synthesis while producing more compact Gaussian representations than the compared methods. These results demonstrate that Gaussian uncertainty provides an effective rendering-time control for sparse-view reconstruction.
tldr: UGOD通过不确定性引导不透明度调制与软丢弃，缓解稀疏视角3DGS过拟合并提升新视角合成。
motivation: 稀疏视角3D Gaussian Splatting因观测有限，许多高斯原语约束不足，但alpha混合仍会累积其贡献；缺乏不确定性估计时，渲染器无法区分不可靠原语与约束良好的原语，错误贡献会污染新视角合成。
method: 提出UGOD，用轻量不确定性头根据高斯属性与视角方向预测逐高斯的视角相关不确定性，并驱动可微不透明度调制，在合成前衰减高不确定性原语；训练时使用分离的软丢弃分支施加不确定性控制的连续保留掩码，且停止不确定性分数梯度，避免该随机正则项偏置或坍缩不确定性预测。
result: 在Mip-NeRF 360与LLFF上的实验表明，UGOD提升了稀疏视角新视角合成质量，并产生比对比方法更紧凑的高斯表示；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 结果表明高斯不确定性可作为渲染时的有效控制用于稀疏视角重建；UGOD的贡献在于通过不确定性引导的不透明度调制与Dropout减少过拟合，并压缩高斯表示，为稀疏视角3DGS提供新思路。

title: Agentic Relative Camera Pose Estimation via Learned Ranking and Verification
abstract: A wide range of approaches have been developed for camera pose estimation, including correspondence-based methods, end-to-end pose regression, and recent 3D geometric foundation models. Our key observation is that no single estimator is optimal for diverse challenges, such as wide baselines, lack of texture, appearance changes, and occlusions. Further analysis reveals substantial performance variation across both benchmarks and individual image pairs, with different estimators exhibiting complementary strengths. We introduce PoseAgent, an agentic framework for relative camera pose estimation that dynamically orchestrates pose estimators through learnable ranking and verification. Given an image pair, a profiling agent first extracts appearance, semantic, and geometric features relevant to pose estimation, e.g., scene type. A learned ranking agent then predicts the relative competence of multiple pose estimators given the image-pair profile. The top-ranked estimator is executed, and its predicted pose is assessed by a learned verification agent that estimates the corresponding pose error. When verification fails, PoseAgent adaptively invokes lower-ranked estimators until a candidate is accepted or the execution budget is reached. For pose verification, our verification network predicts pose errors more accurately than prior models. For pose estimation, PoseAgent improves AUC@5 degree up to 4.2% over the strongest standalone estimator on each of ARKitScenes, MegaDepth, ScanNet++, and RealEstate10K. On ARKitScenes, PoseAgent also outperforms VLM-based agents, which include a VLM ranker with the same verifier and fallback policy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our learned ranking and verification.
tldr: PoseAgent通过可学习排序与验证动态调度多个位姿估计器，在多个基准上提升相对相机位姿估计精度。
motivation: 现有基于对应、端到端回归和3D几何基础模型的位姿估计器在面对宽基线、弱纹理、外观变化和遮挡等挑战时各有优劣，且不同基准与图像对间性能差异显著、互补性强，因此需要动态选择而非固定使用单一估计器。
method: PoseAgent先用profiling agent提取外观、语义和几何特征（如场景类型）形成图像对画像；学习型ranking agent据此预测多个估计器的相对胜任度，执行排名最高者，并由学习型verification agent估计其位姿误差；若验证失败，则按排名依次回退调用更低排名估计器，直到候选被接受或达到执行预算。
result: 在ARKitScenes、MegaDepth、ScanNet++和RealEstate10K上，PoseAgent相对各基准最强单估计器将AUC@5°最高提升4.2%；其验证网络预测位姿误差比先前模型更准；在ARKitScenes上还优于使用相同验证器与回退策略的VLM-based agents。
conclusion: 结果表明学习型排序与验证能有效动态编排异构位姿估计器，缓解单一方法在复杂场景下的局限，为相对相机位姿估计提供可扩展的agentic方案。

title: Matisse: Evidence-Space Reasoning for Active 3D Reconstruction
abstract: How can a 3D reconstruction system acquire and retain useful information to understand the geometry of a scene from partial views under a limited computation budget? Existing active view acquisition methods typically estimate uncertainty over observed or instantiated geometry, limiting their ability to reason about unseen structure, while long-horizon reconstruction methods often retain redundant observations. We introduce Matisse, a training-free framework that unifies active reconstruction and keyframe selection by leveraging evidence provided by a pretrained generative 3D model. Matisse estimates Evidential Uncertainty from cross-attention evidence associated with 3D latent tokens and derives an Evidential Information Gain to guide both view acquisition and keyframe selection based on the expected reduction in posterior entropy. Matisse supports multi-object scenes through occlusion-aware, object-balanced aggregation and propagates uncertainty through intermediate latents to avoid full reconstruction during planning. Matisse reduces Chamfer distance by 12.7%, 3.8%, and 9.2% on GSO30, YCB-V, and Replica, respectively, relative to the best baseline on each dataset, and achieves a $1.50\times$ end-to-end speedup over the best active reconstruction baseline on GSO30 with the same reconstruction backend. In the GSO30 keyframe selection experiment for long-horizon reconstruction, Matisse achieves comparable Chamfer distance using 14% of the input views compared with Stream3D.
tldr: Matisse利用预训练生成式3D模型的证据不确定性，统一主动重建与关键帧选择，提升精度与效率。
motivation: 现有主动视图获取方法通常在已观测或已实例化几何上估计不确定性，难以推理未见结构；长时程重建方法又常保留冗余观测。本文旨在有限计算预算下，让3D重建系统有效获取并保留有用信息以理解场景几何。
method: Matisse是一个无需训练的框架，利用预训练生成式3D模型提供的证据来统一主动重建与关键帧选择。它从3D隐令牌的交叉注意力证据中估计Evidential Uncertainty，并推导Evidential Information Gain，以基于后验熵的预期减少来指导视图获取和关键帧选择。该方法通过遮挡感知、物体平衡的聚合支持多物体场景，并通过中间隐变量传播不确定性，从而在规划时避免完整重建。
result: 在GSO30、YCB-V和Replica上，Matisse相对各数据集最佳基线将Chamfer距离分别降低12.7%、3.8%和9.2%；在GSO30上使用相同重建后端时，相对最佳主动重建基线取得1.50倍端到端加速。在GSO30长时程重建的关键帧选择实验中，Matisse仅用14%的输入视图即可达到与Stream3D相当的Chamfer距离。
conclusion: Matisse表明，基于生成式3D模型证据空间的不确定性推理可有效统一主动视图获取与关键帧选择，在提升重建精度的同时显著减少计算和冗余视图。该框架为有限预算下的主动3D重建与长时程重建提供了训练免费且可扩展的新思路。

title: What Builds the Scene? Luminance Dominates Geometry Formation in 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) learns geometry and appearance jointly from RGB supervision, making it difficult to isolate how luminance and chroma contribute to the learned representation. We study this by training models under different channel supervision, freezing their non-appearance parameters (position, scale, rotation, and opacity), and re-estimating appearance with the same solver before comparing held-out reconstruction. Across eleven benchmark scenes with four independent runs each, geometry learned from luminance alone supports held-out reconstruction 0.085 dB below RGB-trained geometry on average. If chroma is deleted from a trained model, a sufficiently expressive solver can re-fit it on the frozen geometry to the original quality or slightly better. Higher-order spherical harmonics contribute much more reconstruction quality to luminance than to chroma, improving PSNR by 1.44 dB versus 0.19 dB on average, although on mirror-like surfaces hue does still change with viewpoint. The luminance advantage is even larger when geometry is being formed. Chroma-only supervision produces geometry 3.9-5.5 dB worse than luminance-only supervision after the same appearance solve; densification explains part of this gap. Overall, geometry formation in standard 3DGS is strongly luminance-dominated but not luminance-exclusive, and much of the chromatic appearance can be recovered after spatial support has formed.
tldr: 在3DGS中几何形成由亮度主导，色度贡献小且可在冻结几何后重新拟合恢复。
motivation: 标准3DGS从RGB监督中联合学习几何与外观，难以分离亮度与色度对所学表示的各自贡献。作者希望厘清二者在几何形成与外观重建中的作用差异。
method: 在不同通道监督下训练模型，冻结位置、尺度、旋转和不透明度等非外观参数，再用同一求解器重新估计外观，最后比较留出集重建质量。在11个基准场景上各进行4次独立训练。
result: 仅用亮度学习的几何平均仅比RGB训练低0.085 dB；删除色度后，足够强的求解器可在冻结几何上重新拟合至原质量甚至略优。高阶球谐对亮度贡献（+1.44 dB）远大于色度（+0.19 dB）。仅色度监督的几何比仅亮度监督差3.9-5.5 dB，稠密化可部分解释该差距。镜面表面上色相仍随视角变化。
conclusion: 标准3DGS的几何形成强烈由亮度主导但并非完全排斥色度，大部分色度外观可在空间支撑形成后恢复，这为理解与改进3DGS表示学习提供了依据。

title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
abstract: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM, an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM's underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.
tldr: Imagine3D-LLM 通过可学习摘要 token 重建紧凑 3D 高斯表示，提升多视角空间推理能力。
motivation: 多模态大模型处理单图输入有效，但难以整合多视角证据形成连贯3D理解；现有注入3D感知的方法（细粒度像素级跨视图对应或融合3D几何基础模型特征）仍与人类推理存在明显差距。受人类空间推理启发：人类大致识别跨视图共同物体、推断视点间相对几何并组装粗糙3D布局。
method: 提出 Imagine3D-LLM，在图像 token 后附加少量可学习 summary tokens，将其解码为紧凑 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示，并以光度重建损失监督，与标准下一 token 预测目标联合训练。尽管只有 summary tokens 接收直接重建监督，该目标仍增强 LLM 底层图像特征的跨帧对应，说明重建学习可将 3D 感知信号传播至整个模型。
result: 在多个空间推理和3D理解基准上，Imagine3D-LLM 持续优于先前方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，让 MLLM 先想象/重建场景的紧凑3D表示，可能比直接提供像素级几何更有效。该工作贡献在于提出受人类空间推理启发的3D感知 MLLM 框架，并揭示重建目标可诱导更细粒度的跨视图对应。

title: Pow3R-SLAM: Real-Time RGB-D SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
abstract: We present Pow3R-SLAM, a real-time RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that uses Pow3R for tracking and mapping. Inspired by MASt3R-SLAM, a recent work on monocular SLAM using two-view 3D reconstruction priors, we extend the work to incorporate depth as a prior on the network's prediction, rather than as geometry to fuse. Where traditional RGB-D SLAM systems struggle with sparsity in the depth images, Pow3R utilizes the available depth to give a better-conditioned pointmap, while inferring the depths in empty regions from the two-view photometric, depth, and intrinsic data. Evaluated against MASt3R-SLAM following its protocol on 24 sequences from TUM, 7-Scenes, and Replica, Pow3R-SLAM runs 1.6x faster in wall time, has 15% lower mean trajectory error, a 3.1x lower unscaled error, and produces denser maps, with a 30% lower Chamfer distance. We also introduce a hybrid variant that runs 2.1x faster than MASt3R-SLAM at 25.3 frames per second (FPS), while maintaining improved tracking and mapping accuracy. Against ORB-SLAM3 in RGB-D mode, Pow3R-SLAM is more accurate on TUM, 7-Scenes, and ETH3D-SLAM, and completes every TUM sequence. While Pow3R-SLAM can struggle on a small set of self-similar scenes, its overall performance shows that adding depth as a prior for two-view 3D reconstruction SLAM can be beneficial. A project webpage is available at: https://ChrisKolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM , and code will be made open-source upon acceptance.
tldr: Pow3R-SLAM将深度作为双视图3D重建先验，实现更快速、更精确且建图更稠密的实时RGB-D SLAM。
motivation: 传统RGB-D SLAM在深度图稀疏时表现不佳，难以获得稳定跟踪与稠密建图。受MASt3R-SLAM利用双视图3D重建先验进行单目SLAM的启发，本文希望把深度作为网络预测先验而非直接融合的几何信息，以改善跟踪与建图。
method: Pow3R-SLAM使用Pow3R进行实时跟踪与建图，将可用深度作为双视图3D重建网络的先验，从而获得条件更好的pointmap，并利用双视图光度、深度和内参在深度缺失区域推断深度。还提出一种混合变体以进一步提升运行速度。
result: 在TUM、7-Scenes和Replica共24条序列上按MASt3R-SLAM协议评估，Pow3R-SLAM墙钟时间快1.6倍，平均轨迹误差低15%，未缩放误差低3.1倍，Chamfer距离低30%且地图更稠密；混合变体比MASt3R-SLAM快2.1倍，达25.3 FPS，并保持跟踪与建图精度提升。相比RGB-D模式ORB-SLAM3，其在TUM、7-Scenes和ETH3D-SLAM上更准确，并完成所有TUM序列。
conclusion: 结果表明，将深度作为双视图3D重建SLAM的先验能带来明显收益，尽管在少量自相似场景中仍可能遇到困难。系统整体优于MASt3R-SLAM和ORB-SLAM3，项目网页已公开，代码将在接收后开源。

title: ORMA: Optimization-based Monocular 4D Reconstruction of Articulated Animals
abstract: Recovering articulated 4D representations of animals from monocular videos remains challenging due to the large diversity of quadruped morphologies and lack of animal 4D supervision data. Existing learning-based reconstruction methods operate on individual images and rely on synthetic or model-fitted 3D supervision, which inherits the constraints of strong parametric priors and limits generalization to out-of-distribution species. When applied to out-of-distribution animals, they often recover a plausible pose while producing inaccurate geometry because the underlying shape model cannot faithfully represent the observed instance. We present ORMA, a training-free reconstruction framework that decouples articulation from shape, using the predicted pose as reference for optimization while leveraging generative 3D priors for accurate shape reconstruction. Given a reference image, we reconstruct the animal geometry and register it to the parametric model SMAL+, yielding an articulated shape adapted to the observed instance. We then combine per-frame articulated pose estimates with globally consistent camera poses to recover animal motion in a shared world coordinate frame, and further refine the reconstruction using self-supervised DINO correspondences and temporal consistency. To enable quantitative evaluation, we introduce PAW4D, a synthetic multi-species benchmark with ground-truth 3D geometry and camera motion. Experiments on PAW4D, PFERD, and challenging in-the-wild videos demonstrate that ORMA improves reconstruction accuracy while recovering globally consistend animal motion across diverse quadruped species.
tldr: ORMA提出免训练的单目动物4D重建框架，解耦关节与形状并融合生成式3D先验，提升跨物种重建精度与全局运动一致性。
motivation: 从单目视频恢复动物关节化4D表示十分困难，原因是四足动物形态差异大且缺乏动物4D监督数据。现有学习式方法依赖合成数据或模型拟合的3D监督，受强参数化先验约束，对分布外物种泛化差，常出现姿态看似合理但几何不准确的问题。
method: ORMA是免训练重建框架，将关节与形状解耦：以预测姿态作为优化参考，同时利用生成式3D先验重建准确形状。给定参考图像，方法重建动物几何并配准到SMAL+，得到适应观测实例的关节形状；再结合逐帧关节姿态估计与全局一致相机位姿，在共享世界坐标系中恢复运动，并用自监督DINO对应和时间一致性进一步精修。
result: 在PAW4D、PFERD及挑战性野外视频上的实验表明，ORMA提升了重建精度，并能在多种四足物种上恢复全局一致的运动。作者还提出PAW4D合成多物种基准，包含真值3D几何和相机运动；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: ORMA通过免训练优化解耦形状与关节，结合生成式3D先验、自监督对应和时间一致性，缓解了参数化模型先验对分布外动物的限制，为单目动物4D重建提供了更具泛化性的方案，并贡献了PAW4D评测基准。

title: RLX: A Unified Multi-Backend Tensor Compiler and Distributed Runtime in Rust
abstract: Production machine learning (ML) stacks often split graph compilation and kernel execution across different layers and languages, making backend behavior, deployment guarantees, and performance fallbacks hard to reason about end-to-end. RLX addresses this gap with a single Rust codebase that combines compiler and runtime roles around one primitive-level, three-level intermediate representation (IR), plus a transparent dispatch contract that resolves each operator to native, common-IR, or rewritten lowering and fails compilation when legalization is not possible. The same IR targets fourteen runtime devices (cpu, metal, mlx, ane, cuda, rocm, oneapi, tpu, hexagon, gpu, vulkan, opengl, directx, webgpu) and two specialty codegen paths (Cortex-M INT8 and FPGA), ingests safetensors, GGUF, ONNX, and rten formats, supports F16/BF16/F64/C64 and quantized INT4/INT8 flows with AMP/PTQ/QAT, and scales via tensor-/pipeline-parallel collectives over TCP and RDMA transports. Beyond neural workloads, RLX also extends to scientific/physics-style domains through sparse and dense linear algebra extensions (e.g., CSR LU/CG/matvec and LAPACK- backed factorizations) and 3D Gaussian splatting operators. We evaluate RLX against PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, candle, burn, tch, rten, MLX, CoreML, IREE, Glow, TensorRT, and tinygrad under identical input generation and p50 measurement methodology on one host. On all-MiniLM-L6-v2, RLX-Metal is fastest at every batch (e.g., 16.6 ms at batch 32 vs. PyTorch-MPS 26.7 ms). In the MNIST training table, RLX also has the top-throughput entry (graph-fused MLP: 946,487 img/s), above NumPy+BLAS (787,349 img/s), while retaining 100% top-1 parity on reference checks (e.g., Qwen3).
tldr: RLX 以单一 Rust 代码库统一多后端张量编译与分布式运行时，性能超越主流框架。
motivation: 生产级机器学习栈常将图编译与内核执行拆分到不同层次和语言，导致后端行为、部署保证与性能回退难以端到端推理；RLX 旨在用一个统一代码库消除这种割裂。
method: RLX 在单一 Rust 代码库中融合编译器与运行时角色，围绕原语级三层中间表示（IR）与透明分派契约，将每个算子解析为原生、公共 IR 或重写lowering，无法合法化时直接编译失败。同一 IR 面向 14 种运行时设备（cpu、metal、mlx、ane、cuda、rocm、oneapi、tpu、hexagon、gpu、vulkan、opengl、directx、webgpu）与两条专用代码生成路径（Cortex-M INT8、FPGA），支持 safetensors、GGUF、ONNX、rten 格式，F16/BF16/F64/C64 与 INT4/INT8 量化及 AMP/PTQ/QAT，并通过 TCP 与 RDMA 实现张量/流水线并行集合通信，还以稀疏/稠密线性代数扩展（CSR LU/CG/matvec、LAPACK 分解）和 3D 高斯泼溅算子扩展到科学计算领域。
result: 在相同输入生成与 p50 测量方法下，RLX 与 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX、candle、burn、tch、rten、MLX、CoreML、IREE、Glow、TensorRT、tinygrad 对比：all-MiniLM-L6-v2 上 RLX-Metal 在每个 batch 均最快（batch 32 为 16.6 ms，PyTorch-MPS 为 26.7 ms）；MNIST 训练中图融合 MLP 取得最高吞吐 946,487 img/s，高于 NumPy+BLAS 的 787,349 img/s，并在 Qwen3 等参考检查中保持 100% top-1 一致。
conclusion: RLX 证明可用单一 Rust 编译与运行时统一多后端部署，实现端到端可推理的后端行为与性能保证，同时把能力从神经负载延伸至科学计算与 3D 高斯泼溅场景，对统一 ML 系统栈具有实用价值。

title: EndoPrior-GS: Dynamic Endoscopic Reconstruction with a Joint Texture Prior
abstract: Dynamic endoscopic reconstruction is fundamental to robotic surgery and computer-assisted interventions. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) realises real-time rendering, its application to deformable intraoperative environments remains constrained by spurious geometry and varying illuminations. To address these limitations, we introduce EndoPrior-GS, a novel pipeline that explicitly couples frame-extracted vision heuristics and estimated depth maps. EndoPrior-GS derives a joint texture prior from a tool-filtered valid tissue mask, a non-specular photometric filter, and anatomical structural salience, yielding a probability map that guides primitive initialisation and subsequent density control. The prior is further extended to the temporal domain through a texture-aware term that dynamically weighs pairwise primitive contributions during training. We conduct extensive experiments on benchmark datasets EndoNeRF and SCARED, and the obtained results show that our method EndoPrior-GS reduces Flow Error by 27.7% and 25.8% over the representative approaches while preserving competitive rendering quality and real-time rendering speed. Our project website is available at https://jiaqi-huang-77.github.io/EndoPrior-GS/.
tldr: 提出EndoPrior-GS，用联合纹理先验引导动态内窥镜3DGS重建，降低光流误差并保持实时渲染。
motivation: 动态内窥镜重建对机器人手术与计算机辅助干预至关重要，但3DGS在可变形术中环境中受伪几何与光照变化影响，难以直接应用。
method: EndoPrior-GS耦合帧提取的视觉启发式与估计深度图，由工具过滤后的有效组织掩码、非镜面光度过滤和解剖结构显著性构建联合纹理先验，生成概率图以引导图元初始化与密度控制；并通过纹理感知项在时序上动态加权成对图元贡献。
result: 在EndoNeRF和SCARED基准上，Flow Error较代表性方法分别降低27.7%和25.8%，同时保持有竞争力的渲染质量和实时渲染速度。
conclusion: 该方法通过联合纹理先验缓解了动态内窥镜重建中的伪几何与光照问题，提升了变形场景重建精度，并具备用于机器人手术和计算机辅助干预的潜力。

title: WINGS: Reference-Free Gaussian Splatting Inpainting with 3D-Native Generative Priors
abstract: Inpainting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, a key challenge in 3D editing, requires generating plausible content within a masked region of 3D space. Prior approaches rely on 2D diffusion models to produce one or several inpainted reference views, making them susceptible to challenges associated with multi-view inconsistency and lengthy optimization times. Departing from these approaches, we introduce a reference-free Gaussian splatting inpainting method operating natively in 3D. Our method leverages the embedding space of a large, pre-trained 3D prior, combined with a structure completion network to feed a generative prior which reconstructs the missing region's geometry and appearance. Performing content generation entirely in 3D, it avoids the need to reconcile inconsistencies of multiple inpainted reference images, and is faster than related 2D-based methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method qualitatively and quantitatively, through extensive experiments and a user study. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first Gaussian splatting inpainting method to operate in the learned representation space of a 3D-native generative prior without relying on inpainted reference views.
tldr: WINGS提出无需参考视图的3D高斯泼溅修复方法，直接在3D原生生成先验表征空间中补全缺失区域。
motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅修复依赖2D扩散模型生成一张或多张修复参考视图，易受多视图不一致影响且优化时间长。该工作旨在直接在3D空间中生成合理的缺失几何与外观，避免参考视图带来的不一致问题。
method: 方法利用大规模预训练3D先验的嵌入空间，结合结构补全网络将掩码区域输入生成先验，从而重建缺失区域的几何和外观。整个内容生成过程完全在3D空间进行，无需协调多张修复参考图像。
result: 摘要称通过大量实验和用户研究在定性与定量上验证了方法有效性，并比相关2D方法更快。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作是首个在3D原生生成先验的学习表征空间中进行高斯泼溅修复、且不依赖修复参考视图的方法。它避免了多视图不一致问题并提升速度，对3D编辑具有潜在影响。

title: NRF-GS: Neural Residual Fields for Expressive and Compact Gaussian Splatting
abstract: We revisit the role of appearance modeling in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and show that limited expressiveness in view-dependent reflectance is a key driver of representation redundancy. In standard 3DGS, low-order spherical harmonics (SH) are used, restricting the splats' ability to model high-frequency directional effects, which is typically compensated by increasing the number of splats. We propose \emph{NRF-GS: Neural Residual Fields for Gaussian Splatting}, a hybrid representation that replaces per-splat SH-bases with a shared neural residual field. Each Gaussian encodes a compact set of appearance features and a lambertian base color, while a lightweight \emph{global scene-level MLP} predicts view-dependent residuals conditioned on viewing direction, distance, and per-splat features. This formulation enhances directional reflectance modeling by combining diffuse per-splat reflectance representations with a shared global function for high-frequency details, enabling both higher expressiveness and parameter sharing across splats. Our key insight is that by accurately capturing high-frequency directional reflectance, especially in specular regions, the GS-representation becomes more expressive, reducing the need for geometrically redundant splats. As a result, NRF-GS achieves comparable or better rendering quality while reducing the number of Gaussians by up to 50\%, and produces visibly improved specular and high-frequency details.
tldr: NRF-GS用共享神经残差场替代逐高斯SH，提升视角依赖外观表达并将高斯数量减少至多50%。
motivation: 标准3DGS使用低阶球谐函数建模视角相关反射，难以表达高频方向效应，常通过增加splat数量来补偿，导致表示冗余和紧凑性不足。
method: 提出混合表示NRF-GS，将每个高斯的逐splat SH基替换为共享神经残差场：每个高斯仅编码紧凑外观特征与Lambertian基础色，并由轻量全局场景级MLP根据视角方向、距离和逐splat特征预测视角相关残差。该方法结合逐splat漫反射表示与共享全局函数来建模高频细节，在增强方向反射表达的同时实现跨splat参数共享。
result: 实验表明，NRF-GS在渲染质量相当或更优的情况下，将高斯数量减少最多50%，并显著改善镜面反射与高频细节表现。
conclusion: 结果表明，准确建模高频方向反射可提升3DGS表示能力并减少几何冗余，为更紧凑、高效且富有表现力的3D高斯表示提供了新思路。

title: Prior-Driven Enhancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting: Normals and Depths Regularization
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a state-of-the-art technique for 3D scene rendering, offering high efficiency and excellent visual quality. However, because 3DGS relies on an initial sparse point set from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and view-dependent properties, it can suffer from geometric inaccuracies and visual artifacts, particularly in complex scenes. To address these challenges, we propose an improved 3DGS approach that regularizes the optimization process by integrating geometric priors, including surface normals and dense depth information. Surface normal regularization improves geometric consistency by aligning Gaussian covariance with local surface structures, while dense depth priors combined with an initial points from SfM enhance per-pixel depth estimation, increasing accuracy and reducing ambiguities. These enhancements enable robust handling of diverse and complex real-world scenarios, minimizing visual distortions and improving reconstruction quality across various environments. To validate our method, we evaluate it on challenging datasets, including street-view scenes and highly reflective environments, while testing it across multiple SfM pipelines. Our results demonstrate compatibility across diverse environments and highlight the robustness of our approach. Experimental findings further show that our method enhances geometric accuracy and visual quality, establishing a reliable solution for real-time 3D scene rendering in complex environments.
tldr: 本文通过表面法线与稠密深度先验正则化3DGS优化，提升复杂场景的几何精度与渲染质量。
motivation: 3DGS依赖SfM生成的稀疏初始点集和视角相关属性，在复杂场景中容易出现几何不准确和视觉伪影。为缓解这些问题，需要引入几何先验来约束优化过程。
method: 提出一种改进的3DGS方法，将表面法线和稠密深度信息作为几何先验融入优化。表面法线正则化通过将高斯协方差与局部表面结构对齐来提升几何一致性，稠密深度先验结合SfM初始点增强逐像素深度估计并减少歧义。
result: 在街景、高反射等挑战性数据集以及多种SfM流程上进行评估，结果表明方法具有跨环境兼容性和鲁棒性，能提升几何精度与视觉质量。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 法线与深度先验正则化可有效增强3DGS在复杂环境中的重建几何精度和视觉质量，为实时3D场景渲染提供可靠方案。该方法还展现出跨多种SfM流程的兼容性，对复杂真实场景应用具有潜在影响。

title: DispFlow-GS: Displacement Flow Supervision with Motion Disentangling for Monocular Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Accurate dynamic scene reconstruction is important for robotic perception, where temporally consistent representations of dynamic environments are essential. Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models dynamic scenes through deformation fields, and recent methods incorporate motion supervision by aligning rendered Gaussian flow with optical flow. However, we find that such Gaussian-flow-based supervision provides only limited improvements in motion modeling. We identify a fundamental limitation of this supervision paradigm, namely a domain gap between rendered Gaussian flow and optical flow. To address this limitation, we propose a motion supervision framework built on Displacement Flow, which splats per-Gaussian 3D displacements onto the image plane to provide direct and stable optimization signals. We further disentangle scene motion from camera motion via intermediate-view rendering, enabling more reliable motion priors and targeted constraints on deformation and geometry. We also observe a discrepancy between motion fidelity and image-based evaluation, where improved motion awareness does not necessarily translate into better rendered image quality or higher image-based metric scores. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce Deformation-Rendering Consistency (DRC), a motion-aware metric that measures the alignment between predicted deformation and rendering improvement. Experiments on dynamic scene benchmarks show substantial improvements in motion localization and motion--rendering consistency, reaching up to 39% and 6%, respectively, while image-based metrics change by only about 0.1%. These results confirm the observed mismatch between motion fidelity and image-based evaluation, demonstrating the significance of DRC for motion-aware evaluation.
tldr: 提出位移流监督与运动解耦的可变形3DGS框架，并引入DRC运动感知指标。
motivation: 可变形3DGS通常将渲染的高斯流与光流对齐以施加运动监督，但作者发现该范式因渲染高斯流与光流之间存在域间隙，对运动建模的提升十分有限。同时，运动保真度的提升并不一定带来更好的渲染图像质量，暴露出运动感知与图像指标评价之间的错配问题。
method: 提出基于Displacement Flow的运动监督框架，将每个高斯的3D位移直接投影到图像平面，提供直接且稳定的优化信号；并通过中间视角渲染将场景运动与相机运动解耦，获得更可靠的运动先验并对形变与几何施加针对性约束。此外提出形变-渲染一致性（DRC）指标，衡量预测形变与渲染提升之间的对齐程度。
result: 在动态场景基准上，运动定位能力最高提升39%，运动-渲染一致性最高提升6%，而基于图像的指标仅变化约0.1%，定量验证了运动保真度与图像评价之间存在错配。
conclusion: 该工作揭示了高斯流-光流监督的域间隙瓶颈，用位移流监督与运动解耦实现更有效的运动建模，并指出传统图像指标难以反映运动质量，所提出的DRC为运动感知评价提供了新标准，对机器人感知等需时序一致动态表征的应用具有潜在价值。

title: SFE-VGGT: Source-Free VGGT Distillation for Event-Based Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: Recent event-based depth estimation methods successfully transfer geometric priors from vision foundation models via cross-modal distillation. However, their reliance on synchronized RGB-event pairs or depth annotations during training severely restricts practical deployment. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose SFE-VGGT, a novel source-free framework that distills the geometric priors of VGGT to the event domain without any paired RGB observations. Our core idea is to reconstruct surrogate frames directly from the target event stream to act as a frozen geometric teacher, entirely eliminating the need for genuine source RGB data. Crucially, as these surrogate frames inherently yield imperfect and spatially varying supervision, directly distilling from them propagates artifacts. To resolve this, we introduce a novel reliability-aware distillation strategy. This includes Density-Aware Feature Distillation to emphasize informative event regions, and Confidence-Weighted Depth Distillation to dynamically regulate supervision based on relative teacher-student prediction confidence. Meanwhile, we propose a Cross-Frame Relational Consistency loss that enforces temporal geometric stability using reliable inter-frame correspondences, bypassing the need for temporally consistent teacher's depth. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, despite source-free, our SFE-VGGT closely matches the accuracy of RGB-dependent baselines under standard conditions and significantly surpasses them in challenging nighttime scenarios. Across MVSEC nighttime sequences, SFE-VGGT reduces the average 10 m depth error by 15.3% compared with EventVGGT. Moreover, our method exhibits robust zero-shot generalization across real-world datasets, proving that highly effective geometric priors can be transferred to event cameras using strictly source-free supervision.
tldr: SFE-VGGT 用事件流重建代理帧作冻结教师，无需配对 RGB 即可实现事件单目深度估计蒸馏。
motivation: 现有事件相机深度估计依赖跨模态蒸馏迁移视觉基础模型的几何先验，但训练阶段需要同步的 RGB-事件配对数据或深度标注，严重限制实际部署。本文旨在完全去除真实源域 RGB 观测，实现无源的几何先验迁移。
method: 直接从目标事件流重建代理帧并冻结 VGGT 作为几何教师，从而摆脱对源 RGB 数据的依赖；针对代理帧监督不完美且空间不均匀的问题，提出可靠性感知蒸馏策略，包括强调有效事件区域的密度感知特征蒸馏与按师生相对预测置信度动态调节监督强度的置信度加权深度蒸馏，并引入跨帧关系一致性损失，用可靠帧间对应关系约束时序几何稳定性，无需时序一致的教师深度。
result: 实验表明该无源方法在标准条件下精度接近依赖 RGB 的基线，在夜间困难场景显著优于基线：在 MVSEC 夜间序列上，平均 10 m 深度误差相比 EventVGGT 降低 15.3%；同时在多个真实数据集上展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。
conclusion: 该工作证明仅凭严格的无源监督即可将强几何先验有效迁移到事件相机，为免配对 RGB 的事件深度估计提供了可行范式，并提升了夜间等挑战性场景的实用性。

title: Does the VGGT Family Need All Its Layers?
abstract: Which layers of a feed-forward geometry model are needed to preserve both camera poses and dense 3D structure? We study layer redundancy in VGGT, $π^3$, and VGGT-$Ω$: 3,018 pruned configurations, scored on seven camera-pose and dense-geometry metrics across four indoor and outdoor datasets. Four findings follow: (i) Removable layers cluster in two redundancy regions: a dominant early region and a narrower late one, while deletions spanning the intervening layers are consistently more disruptive. This recurring pattern holds across models, datasets, and metrics, and contrasts with the middle-to-late redundancy commonly reported in the literature. (ii) Within these regions, we observe that the joint degradation from deleting two intervals is approximately the sum of their individual degradations, reducing the number of model evaluations for pruning search from $O(L^4)$ to $O(L^2)$, where $L$ is the aggregator depth. (iii) We find that CKA provides a cheaper representation-based proxy for interval degradation, offering a practical trade-off between pruning quality and calibration cost. (iv) Closed-form linear calibration recovers accuracy after pruning without end-to-end retraining. A least-squares analysis shows that using a shared map for special and patch tokens generally incurs excess reconstruction loss, motivating token-aware recovery. Recovery maps fitted on just 100 calibration scenes generalize to held-out scenes and unseen datasets. The resulting models reduce aggregator parameters by up to 44% while maintaining accuracy comparable to their intact counterparts. Code and experimental results will be available at our project page: https://xian-bei.github.io/vggt-family-layer-redundancy/
tldr: 系统分析VGGT家族层冗余，发现早/晚冗余区，并实现剪枝后线性校准，聚合器参数最多减44%。
motivation: 探究前馈几何模型VGGT、π^3、VGGT-Ω中哪些层对相机位姿和稠密3D结构至关重要，以定位层冗余并指导剪枝。
method: 在四个室内外数据集、七项相机位姿与稠密几何指标上评估3,018种剪枝配置；分析层删除影响与双区间联合退化可加性，并用CKA作为区间退化代理及闭式线性校准进行token-aware恢复。
result: 可删除层集中在主导的早期冗余区和较窄的晚期冗余区，跨中间层删除更破坏性能；双区间联合退化近似可加，将剪枝搜索从O(L^4)降至O(L^2)；仅用100个校准场景拟合的恢复映射可泛化到新场景/数据集，聚合器参数最多减少44%且精度与完整模型相当。
conclusion: 证明VGGT家族层冗余呈早/晚模式而非中后期冗余，并提供可加性、CKA代理与闭式校准的高效剪枝恢复方案；在不端到端重训练下大幅压缩聚合器参数，对前馈几何模型部署有实用价值。

title: AESplat: Advancing Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Decoupled Appearance Modeling
abstract: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable potential for generalized novel view synthesis. However, existing methods typically predict Gaussian appearance attributes represented by spherical harmonics (SH) in the same manner, overlooking the fundamental distinction between view-independent and view-dependent appearance, which results in suboptimal rendering quality. In this paper, we present AESplat, a novel and general framework for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS that introduces an effective decoupled appearance modeling strategy based on an analysis of SH, enabling higher-quality rendering. Specifically, AESplat directly derives the zeroth-order SH coefficient, which represents the base view-independent appearance component, from the input images without training. The higher-order SH coefficients are subsequently predicted by a shallow multilayer perceptron equipped with two efficient 3D-aware inductive biases to model view-dependent appearance variations. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a $0.8$ dB improvement in PSNR over the pose-free method NAS3R and a $1.1$ dB improvement over the pose-required method DepthSplat on the RealEstate10K dataset. Project page: https://aesplat.github.io/.
tldr: AESplat通过解耦外观建模，从输入图像获取零阶SH并预测高阶SH，提升无位姿前馈3DGS渲染质量。
motivation: 现有无位姿前馈3DGS通常以相同方式预测球谐函数外观属性，忽视了视角无关与视角相关外观的本质区别，导致渲染质量不理想。
method: 提出AESplat通用框架，采用解耦外观建模：零阶SH系数直接从输入图像推导、无需训练，表示视角无关基础外观；高阶SH系数由浅层MLP结合两种高效3D感知归纳偏置预测，建模视角相关外观变化。
result: 在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法；在RealEstate10K上，PSNR相比无位姿方法NAS3R提升0.8 dB，相比需位姿方法DepthSplat提升1.1 dB。
conclusion: AESplat验证了解耦外观建模对无位姿前馈3DGS的有效性，可作为提升泛化新视角合成渲染质量的通用框架。

title: SCCM: Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching for ERP Dense Feature Correspondence
abstract: Equirectangular projection (ERP) is the standard representation for 360$^\circ$ imagery, and robust dense feature matching on ERP underpins panoramic stereo, view synthesis, and omnidirectional SLAM. Dense matchers trained on flat images degrade systematically on ERP because the chart introduces three coupled distortions -- topological, metric, and area -- that standard coarse matching and visibility estimation do not explicitly model. We show that correcting the three distortions at the coarse-stage interfaces where they arise -- pairwise distortions in attention, per-pixel distortion in covisibility gating -- improves PCK@$1^\circ$ from 0.229 to 0.275 on Matterport3D under a fixed coarse scaffold, with the refiner architecture unchanged -- our central result. Concretely, SCCM (Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching) augments a chart-naive cross-attention/dual-softmax coarse matcher with two sphere-derived priors: Spherical Positional Attention (SPA) pairs a yaw-periodic RoPE (topology) with a tangent-plane bias (metric), and Area-Aware Covisibility (AAC) applies a pre-sigmoid log-area correction (area). The chart-naive scaffold serves as a controlled reference, separating the scaffold-replacement effect from the spherical-prior effect. Instantiated in the RoMa V1 framework with the same frozen encoder, refiner architecture, and loss, SCCM also outperforms the ERP-native EDM (0.163) and an ERP-retrained RoMa V1 (0.198) under a unified ERP dense matching protocol, while perspective-trained matchers largely fail on ERP. It further transfers zero-shot to Stanford2D3D and, when trained on outdoor Holo360D, leads there as well.
tldr: SCCM在粗匹配阶段引入球面先验校正ERP的拓扑、度量和面积畸变，显著提升全景稠密特征匹配精度。
motivation: ERP是360°图像的标准表示，但平面图像训练的稠密匹配器在ERP上因三种耦合畸变（拓扑、度量、面积）而系统性退化，标准粗匹配和可见性估计未显式建模这些畸变。
method: SCCM在粗匹配阶段显式校正三种畸变：Spherical Positional Attention (SPA)将yaw周期RoPE（拓扑）与切平面偏置（度量）结合，Area-Aware Covisibility (AAC)在sigmoid前施加对数面积校正（面积）。在RoMa V1框架中实例化，保持编码器、细化器架构和损失不变，以图表无关骨架作为受控参考。
result: 在Matterport3D上，固定粗匹配骨架和细化器不变，PCK@1°从0.229提升至0.275；在统一ERP稠密匹配协议下，SCCM优于ERP原生EDM（0.163）和ERP重训练的RoMa V1（0.198），而透视训练的匹配器大多失败。零样本迁移到Stanford2D3D，在Holo360D户外训练上也领先。
conclusion: 表明在粗阶段校正球面畸变能有效提升ERP稠密匹配，SCCM作为通用球面一致性粗匹配模块，可推动全景立体、视图合成和全向SLAM等应用。

title: Distilling Privileged Control Barrier Functions into RGB-Only Safety Filters for Dynamic Visual Navigation
abstract: RGB-only end-to-end visual navigation policies remain vulnerable to collisions in real-world dynamic environments, motivating a dedicated safety layer. Existing visual Control Barrier Function (CBF) approaches seek to provide safety from RGB observations, but often rely on real-time rendering or explicit scene reconstruction and are primarily designed for static scenes, limiting their practicality for onboard deployment. We propose a teacher-student visual distillation framework that transfers the safety behavior of a privileged CBF teacher to an RGB-only student filter for dynamic environments. The student maps a short RGB history, robot velocity, and a nominal control action directly to a safe action, while the teacher uses ground-truth robot and obstacle states in a real-to-sim dynamic Gaussian Splatting environment. To reduce the teacher-student information gap, the teacher constructs safety constraints only from obstacles observable within the student's RGB history. It also accounts for obstacle-velocity uncertainty to improve robustness to motion variations, while action augmentation exposes the student to diverse safe and unsafe nominal actions to better capture the safety boundary. At deployment, the student requires only RGB observations and robot velocity, without explicit 3D reconstruction or online rendering. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms visual CBF baselines and improves the safety of RGB-based navigation policies under dynamic obstacle motion. Project page: https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/.
tldr: 将特权CBF教师蒸馏为仅用RGB的学生安全滤波器，提升动态视觉导航安全性。
motivation: RGB端到端视觉导航策略在真实动态环境中易发生碰撞，因此需要独立安全层。现有视觉CBF方法多依赖实时渲染或显式场景重建，且主要面向静态场景，难以在机载端实际部署。
method: 提出教师-学生视觉蒸馏框架，将使用真值机器人与障碍状态、在real-to-sim动态Gaussian Splatting环境中构造约束的特权CBF教师，蒸馏为仅输入短RGB历史、机器人速度和名义控制动作的学生安全滤波器。教师仅利用学生RGB历史中可见障碍构造安全约束，并建模障碍速度不确定性；动作增强则让学生覆盖多样安全与不安全名义动作。部署时学生无需显式3D重建或在线渲染。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；实验报告所提方法优于视觉CBF基线，并在动态障碍运动下提升RGB导航策略的安全性。
conclusion: 该工作提出一种将特权CBF蒸馏为RGB-only安全滤波器的框架，降低了视觉安全导航对重建和渲染的依赖，为动态环境下机载RGB机器人提供更实用的安全层。潜在影响是推动仅视觉感知的机器人在复杂动态场景中实现更安全导航。

title: TSGL: Teacher-Student Graph Learning for 3DGS Compression
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a popular representation for novel view synthesis. However, 3DGS contains millions of Gaussian primitives, each with rich attributes, resulting in large file sizes. We propose a novel 3DGS compression method based on Teacher-Student Graph Learning (TSGL) that operates directly on a trained model, without 3DGS retraining or access to training images. Specifically, for each block of Gaussian primitives, using decoded positions and DC spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients as predictors, we learn a signal-dependent geometry graph G encoding the pairwise similarities between neighbouring Gaussians via a teacher-student model. Given G, we perform Graph Fourier Transform (GFT) on the remaining attributes, so that signal energies are predominantly projected into the low-frequency coefficients for compact representation. On three standard benchmarks, the method reaches 27x to 33x compression with less than 0.6 dB of PSNR loss, improving on recent post-training compression methods in both size and rendering quality.
tldr: 提出TSGL，用师生图学习对训练好的3DGS进行免重训练压缩，在三个基准上实现27–33倍压缩且PSNR损失小于0.6 dB。
motivation: 3DGS包含数百万个高斯基元且属性丰富，导致文件体积巨大，难以存储和传输。现有压缩方法通常需要重训练或访问训练图像，TSGL旨在直接压缩已训练模型，免除这些限制。
method: 对每个高斯基元块，以解码位置和DC球谐系数为预测因子，通过教师-学生模型学习信号相关的几何图G，编码相邻高斯之间的相似度。基于G对剩余属性执行图傅里叶变换GFT，使信号能量主要集中到低频系数，从而实现紧凑表示。
result: 在三个标准基准上，TSGL达到27倍到33倍压缩率，PSNR损失低于0.6 dB，在压缩尺寸和渲染质量上均优于近期后训练压缩方法。
conclusion: TSGL证明了无需3DGS重训练或访问训练图像即可实现高效压缩，兼顾高压缩率与渲染质量，为3DGS的存储和传输提供了有效的后训练压缩方案。

title: Eulerian Motion Reconstruction for Water Scenery
abstract: Reconstructing and animating water scenery from nature produces compelling and immersive visual experiences. Previous work examined this task from the perspective of 2D video textures, with the goal of creating a looping video. In our work, we tackle the problem from a 3D perspective, creating a looping 4D dynamic reconstruction which can be interactively rendered from novel viewpoints from a single non-looping 2D source video. We represent motion as a 3D static \textit{Eulerian} motion field that advects canonical Gaussian splats that are cyclically reborn at fixed time periods, supervised using rendering losses. To model non-periodic and stochastic dynamics present in real-world scenes, we add a non-periodic, time-varying residual term to capture deviations from the static Eulerian motion field. We show quantitatively and qualitatively that our framework enables photorealistic animation of water scenes better than prior art.
tldr: 提出基于欧拉运动场与高斯泼溅的单视频4D水景重建方法，可循环播放并支持新视角渲染。
motivation: 先前工作多从2D视频纹理角度生成固定视角的循环视频，难以支持3D新视角交互渲染。本文旨在从单段非循环2D源视频出发，重建可循环播放、可交互式新视角渲染的4D动态水景。
method: 将运动表示为静态3D Eulerian运动场，用其平流规范Gaussian splats，并让splats按固定时间周期循环重生，以渲染损失进行监督；同时加入随时间变化的非周期残差项，以建模真实场景中的非周期与随机动态。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；作者在定量与定性比较中表明，该框架能实现照片级真实的水景动画，并优于先前方法。
conclusion: 该方法实现了从单段非循环视频出发的循环4D水景重建与交互式新视角渲染，通过Eulerian运动场加残差建模提升动态水体表现，对视频驱动4D场景重建与水景动画具有潜在影响。

title: StereoGaussians: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Stereo Images
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables reconstruction without per- scene optimisation, but practical stereo-camera applications require nearby-view extrapolation beyond the input views. Stereo depth anchors visible surfaces, yet rendering newly exposed regions also requires learned appearance and additional scene capacity. We introduce StereoGaussians, which predicts a metric 3DGS representation from a single calibrated stereo pair. It reuses intermediate repre- sentations from frozen pretrained stereo networks to predict Gaussian attributes, while calibrated disparity anchors the geometry. A second Gaussian layer and an expanded image canvas provide capacity for disoccluded and outside-field-of- view content. For training, we construct SceneSplat-Stereo from quality-filtered 3DGS teachers, pairing stereo inputs with nearby target views across 803 training scenes. Experiments on unseen real and photorealistic stereo benchmarks demon- strate improvements over strong view-synthesis baselines, while ablation studies support our main design choices.
tldr: 提出StereoGaussians，从单组标定立体图前馈预测度量3DGS，实现近邻视角外推。
motivation: 前馈3DGS可避免逐场景优化，但实际立体相机应用需要超越输入视角的近邻外推；仅靠立体深度锚定可见表面，难以渲染新暴露区域，还需学习外观与额外场景容量。
method: StereoGaussians复用冻结预训练立体网络的中间表示预测高斯属性，并用标定视差锚定几何；增加第二高斯层与扩展图像画布以建模去遮挡和视场外内容。训练时从质量过滤的3DGS教师构建SceneSplat-Stereo，覆盖803个场景，将立体输入与近邻目标视角配对。
result: 在未见过的真实与照片级真实感立体基准上，方法优于强视图合成基线；消融研究支持主要设计选择。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作实现了从单组标定立体图前馈生成度量3DGS并支持近邻视角外推，为实践立体相机应用提供新思路，并贡献了SceneSplat-Stereo数据集与相关设计验证。

title: Gaussian Stippling: Efficient Sorting-Free 3D Gaussian Rendering through Hybrid Sampling and Spatiotemporal Reconstruction
abstract: Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) requires depth sorting and ordered alpha blending to correctly render overlapping Gaussian primitives. Stochastic transparency enables sorting-free rendering by replacing fractional alpha contributions with discrete stochastic visibility samples, but produces substantial spatial and temporal noise at low sample counts. We refer to this conversion from continuous Gaussian splats to discrete visibility samples as \textit{Gaussian Stippling}. Based on this, we present an efficient order-independent rendering and reconstruction framework that operates directly on unmodified 3DGS assets. Our method adaptively integrates primitive-based and fragment-based stippling, leveraging their complementary strengths across different rendering regimes to significantly improve rendering throughput. To recover high-quality images from sparse stochastic samples, we further introduce a lightweight Gaussian-aware spatiotemporal reconstruction network. By exploiting the Gaussian attributes retained by each stipple, the network aggregates structured stochastic clues across both space and time, effectively suppressing stippling noise. Experiments show that our hybrid Gaussian stippling method, coupled with a spatiotemporal reconstruction network trained on diverse scenes, generalizes to unseen scenes and enables interactive, temporally stable, and visually plausible rendering on mobile devices without retraining or preprocessing. With scene-specific training and appropriately scaled sampling and network capacity, our method further outperforms the baselines in visual quality, offering a high-fidelity configuration for quality-prioritized applications.
tldr: 提出高斯点画混合采样与时空重建，实现免排序、可在移动端交互渲染的3DGS。
motivation: 传统3DGS依赖深度排序与有序alpha混合，随机透明虽可免排序，但在低采样下会产生明显空间与时间噪声。本文旨在解决免排序渲染中的噪声与效率问题，并直接支持未修改的3DGS资产。
method: 将连续高斯splat转换为离散可见性样本，称为Gaussian Stippling；自适应融合primitive-based与fragment-based stippling以提升吞吐，并引入轻量Gaussian-aware时空重建网络，利用每个stipple保留的高斯属性聚合时空随机线索以抑制噪声。
result: 在多样场景上训练的时空重建网络可泛化到未见场景，无需重训练或预处理即可在移动端实现交互式、时序稳定且视觉合理的渲染；场景特定训练并扩大采样与网络容量后，视觉质量超越基线，提供高保真配置。
conclusion: 该框架可直接作用于未修改3DGS资产，实现高效免排序渲染与重建，兼顾移动端实时性与高质量应用需求，对交互式3DGS渲染具有潜在影响。

title: Curating Synthetic Data for Task-Specific Visual Perception
abstract: Synthetic data are most valuable where general-purpose datasets cannot provide the domain-specific priors a task requires, and where manual annotation is expensive, imprecise, or infeasible. In this article we argue that the central question for specialized vision systems is not how to generate more data, but which data to generate. We therefore discuss curated synthetic data, whose scene content, appearance variations, sensing characteristics, and annotations are deliberately designed around a given task. We examine three complementary curation paradigms. Procedural rendering offers explicit control over scene parameters and the annotations follow by construction. Physically-based simulation encodes the mechanism behind an observed effect and yields exactly aligned supervision pairs. Generative AI learns sensor-specific appearance from small real seed sets and attains plausible realism, though it remains prone to hallucination and to inaccurate annotation. These paradigms are illustrated with examples from industrial surface defect detection, restoration of degraded digitized autochrome plates, and 6DoF pose estimation from RGB and event data. Using these examples, we analyze different data regimes and training strategies that combine synthetic and real data across these paradigms. We conclude that curated synthetic data are best understood as a complement to real observations, and that hybrid pipelines combining controllable supervision with learned appearance are the most promising direction for reliable sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: 本文主张面向任务的视觉感知应关注生成哪些合成数据，并提出程序化渲染、物理仿真与生成式AI三种策展范式。
motivation: 通用数据集无法提供任务所需的领域先验，且人工标注昂贵、不精确或不可行，因此专用视觉系统需要定制合成数据。核心问题不是生成更多数据，而是确定应生成哪些数据。
method: 提出策展合成数据，围绕任务设计场景内容、外观变化、传感特性和标注，并比较三种范式：程序化渲染直接控制场景参数且标注天然对齐；物理仿真编码观测效应机制并生成精确对齐监督对；生成式AI从少量真实种子学习传感器特定外观，但易产生幻觉和标注不准。还分析不同数据机制及合成与真实数据结合的混合训练策略。

conclusion: 策展合成数据应被视为真实观测的补充，而非替代；结合可控监督与学习外观的混合流水线，是实现可靠 sim-to-real 迁移最有前景的方向。
